hadith.chapterTitle: The Excellence of waiting for As-Salat (The Prayer)
hadith.body:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The angels supplicate in favour of one of you so long as he remains in the place where he has performed Salat (prayer) in a state of Wudu'. They (the angels) say: 'O Allah! Forgive him, O Allah! Have mercy on him."'

[Al- Bukhari].
- وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏:‏ الملائكة تصلي على أحدكم ما دام في مصلاه الذي صلى فيه ما لم يحدث تقول اللهم اغفر له اللهم ارحمه‏"‏ ‏(‏‏(‏رواه البخاري‏)‏‏)‏

Abu Hurairah (Semoga Allah meredainya) menceritakan: Rasulullah (ﷺ) bersabda, "Malaikat mendoakan salah seorang daripada kamu selagi dia berada di tempat dia menunaikan solat dalam keadaan berwudhu'. Mereka (malaikat) berkata: 'Ya Allah! Ampunkanlah dia, Ya Allah! Rahmatilah dia.'" [Al-Bukhari].
